items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: After I got good I take the job for him. Yeah. So that's Bobo.

ctx.x: You took his job? Yeah. Oh yeah?

Yeah. What band was that? He had a little band in the Nile Jays. And Edmund Payton used to play in the ghetto. A little fellow, he called him Edmund Payton. That's a long time for him. That's a long time for him. So I take the job. After I got good I take the job for him. Yeah. So that's Bobo. You've got some of this old stuff.
Well I don't know anything about Payton.

items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: But they had another band after it. Before that, before we played that, Edmund Payton. And uh... Payton you say that? Edmund Payton. Edmund Payton. And uh... Boo Boo. Left hand... Bass player? Left hand violin player. Boo Boo, yeah. Yeah, Boo Boo. You know his real name, anybody? I don't know Boo Boo. And uh, who was playing uh... Uh... Some of them, I don't know who was playing uh... Playing bass with him. I don't know, but they had four.

You're a father. Yeah. Well that had, that was before. You understand? Then we come out with five pieces. Six pieces. Heisman used to have six pieces. Of course they didn't have no sax, they didn't have no drums, no piano. Yeah. And after a while they come and see you in the piano.
